# React Native Styled System

> A styled-system implementation for React Native. Converts theme tokens into React Native styles via hooks and HOC patterns.

Package: `@react-native-styled-system/core`

## Installation

```sh
npm install @react-native-styled-system/core
```

## Quick Start

Wrap your app with `StyledSystemProvider` and pass a theme:

```tsx
import { StyledSystemProvider, defaultTheme } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const App = () => (
  <StyledSystemProvider theme={defaultTheme}>
    <MyApp />
  </StyledSystemProvider>
);
```

Create styled components using `useSx` hook or `createSxComponent` HOC:

```tsx
import { View, ViewProps } from 'react-native';
import { SxProps, useSx } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const Box = (props: ViewProps & SxProps) => {
  const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props);
  return <View style={getStyle()} {...filteredProps} />;
};

// Usage
<Box bg={'blue.500'} p={'4'} radius={'md'} />
```

## Theme

A theme is an object matching `ThemedDict`:

```ts
type ThemedDict = {
  space: Record<string, SpaceValue>;
  sizes: Record<string, SizesValue>;
  colors: Record<string, ColorsValue>;
  radii: Record<string, RadiiValue>;
  typography: Record<string, TypographyValue>;
  breakpoints?: number[];
};
```

### defaultTheme

Pre-built theme with Tailwind CSS v4 full palette (22 color groups, shades 50-950), shadcn/ui semantic colors, 4px spacing scale, radii (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/full), typography presets (h1-h3, body, caption, small), and breakpoints [480, 768, 1024].

### createTheme

Build a theme from scratch or extend an existing one.

Extend mode (two arguments) - each token group is shallow-merged, breakpoints is replaced:

```ts
import { createTheme, defaultTheme } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const theme = createTheme(defaultTheme, {
  colors: { brand: '#FF6600' },
  space: { pagePadding: 20 },
  breakpoints: [480, 1024],
});
```

Create mode (single argument) - missing groups default to `{}`, breakpoints to `[]`:

```ts
const theme = createTheme({
  colors: { primary: '#3B82F6' },
  space: { '1': 4, '2': 8 },
});
```

### createThemeColors

Generates light/dark semantic color sets following shadcn/ui convention:

```ts
import { createThemeColors } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';

const { light, dark } = createThemeColors({
  base: 'zinc',   // 'slate' | 'gray' | 'zinc' | 'neutral' | 'stone'
  theme: 'blue',  // any Tailwind color name
});
```

Semantic tokens: background, foreground, card, card-foreground, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, secondary-foreground, muted, muted-foreground, accent, accent-foreground, destructive, destructive-foreground, border, input, ring, chart-1 through chart-5.

## Hooks

### useSx

Primary hook. Takes component props and options, returns `{ getStyle, filteredProps }`.

```ts
const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props, {
  styleType: 'ViewStyle' | 'TextStyle',
  fallback: { bg: 'white', p: 4 },
  transform: (style) => ({ mx: style.marginTop }),
  cache: true,
});
```

Style priority (highest to lowest): style prop > sx prop > direct props > fallback.

### useSxStyle

Creates inline style objects from SxProps:

```ts
const getSxStyle = useSxStyle();
const style = getSxStyle({ bg: 'red', mt: 2 });
```

### useSxTokens

Retrieves raw token values:

```ts
const [bgColor, errorColor] = useSxTokens('colors', ['gray200', 'red500']);
```

## Style Props (SxProps)

All props except `transform` support responsive arrays.

### Color Props
- `backgroundColor` / `bg` - Token<'colors'>
- `borderColor` - Token<'colors'>
- `color` (TextStyle) - Token<'colors'>

### Space Props
- Margin: `m`, `mt`, `mr`, `mb`, `ml`, `mx`, `my`
- Padding: `p`, `pt`, `pr`, `pb`, `pl`, `px`, `py`
- Position: `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`
- Gap: `gap`, `gapX`, `gapY`

### Size Props
- `w`, `minW`, `maxW`, `h`, `minH`, `maxH`

### Radii Props
- `radius`, `topLeftRadius`, `topRightRadius`, `bottomLeftRadius`, `bottomRightRadius`

### Typography
- `t` - Token<'typography'> (applies font properties)
- TextStyle props: `color`, `fontSize`, `fontWeight`, `lineHeight`, `letterSpacing`, `textAlign`, `fontFamily`, `fontStyle`, `textDecorationLine`, `textDecorationColor`

### View Props
- Flex: `flex`, `alignItems`, `alignContent`, `justifyContent`, `flexWrap`, `flexDirection`, `flexGrow`, `flexShrink`, `flexBasis`, `alignSelf`
- Position: `position` / `pos`
- Border: `borderWidth`, `borderTopWidth`, `borderRightWidth`, `borderBottomWidth`, `borderLeftWidth`
- Other: `opacity`, `overflow`, `transform`, `aspectRatio`, `display`, `elevation`, `zIndex`

### Shortcuts
- `absoluteFill` - position: absolute + top/right/bottom/left: 0
- `center` - justifyContent: center + alignItems: center

## Responsive Breakpoints

Pass arrays to apply different values at each breakpoint (mobile-first):

```tsx
// breakpoints: [480, 768, 1024]
<Box w={[100, 200, 300, 400]} bg={['red.500', 'blue.500']} />
```

Array indices: [base, >=bp1, >=bp2, >=bp3]. Last value persists for larger screens.

## Component Patterns

### HOC Pattern

```tsx
import { createSxComponent } from '@react-native-styled-system/core';
const StyledView = createSxComponent(View)();
```

### Text Component

```tsx
const Txt = (props: TextProps & TextSxProps) => {
  const { getStyle, filteredProps } = useSx(props, { styleType: 'TextStyle' });
  return <Text style={getStyle()} {...filteredProps} />;
};

<Txt t={'h1'} color={'primary'} mt={'4'}>Hello</Txt>
```

## Dark Mode

Wrap `createTheme` in `useMemo` when the theme depends on dynamic values to avoid creating a new object every render:

```tsx
const { light, dark } = createThemeColors({ base: 'neutral', theme: 'blue' });

const theme = useMemo(
  () => createTheme(defaultTheme, { colors: isDarkMode ? dark : light }),
  [isDarkMode],
);

<StyledSystemProvider theme={theme}>
```

## TypeScript

Generate type-safe token keys via CLI:

```sh
npx generate-theme-type src/AppTheme.ts
```

This generates interface augmentation for `ThemedTypings`, enabling autocomplete for all token keys.
